contexts.text: All souls are endowed with this gift...
Spirits do not know that... they are provided with so excellent a gift...
Everyone according to his own gift... SE 2993:end.
God hath endowed me with a good dowry (). Explained.

The dowry and gift which he said that they should multiply upon him () = agreement into one; for the dowry which was given to a virgin about to be betrothed, was a token of agreement on both sides... The reason the dowry was a token of agreement, and thus a confirmation of initiation, is that to weigh or give silver was a sign that it was his, thus that the virgin was his, and to accept it was what is reciprocal; thus the bride belonged to the bridegroom and the bridegroom to the bride.
In proportion as he excels in the gift of reasoning and perverting...
He who excels in the gift of thinking and perceiving...
Endowing he shall endow her to himself for a woman () = a token of consent on his own part to a lawful conjunction. A dowry and to endow = a token of consent.
The dowry of virgins () = a token of consent to conjunction.
They who excel in the gift of cleverness...
That Souls... and Spirits far excel in gifts...
Besides the gifts with which Souls are endowed donantur...
According to each one's gift of reception...
Had been esteemed for his endowments of cleverness...
To despise others because they are not of any cleverness, gift...
She is among the worst there, because she had excelled in the gift of cleverness.
